# spectra: `ScanList`

The `data` payload of `openreadout spectra FILE --json` (`--ms-level`, `--polarity`, `--rt A-B`, `--precursor MZ`, `--charge`, `--count`), inside the [envelope](envelope.md).

Output of `spectra` (scan list): the matching scans of one run, one page of them listed.

JSON Schema: [`docs/schema/spectra.schema.json`](https://github.com/openreadout/openreadout/blob/main/docs/schema/spectra.schema.json) · also printed by `openreadout self schema spectra`.

## Fields

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `string` | yes | The input file. |
| `format` | `string` | yes | Format id of the input file. |
| `run` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Run index. |
| `scan_count` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Spectra in the run. |
| `source` | `string` | yes | `headers` when the reader listed scan headers without decoding peaks, `spectra` when every spectrum had to be decoded to list it. |
| `filter` | [`ScanFilter`](#scanfilter) |  | The conditions applied (omitted when every scan is listed). |
| `matched` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Scans matching the conditions (all of them are counted, not only the page listed). |
| `offset` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Position of the first listed scan among the matching ones (0-based; `--offset`). |
| `returned` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Number of scans listed. |
| `truncated` | `boolean` | yes | True when more matching scans follow the page (`offset + returned < matched`). |
| `ms_level_counts` | object: string → `integer` (uint64) | yes | Counts of the matching scans per MS level (`"1"`, `"2"`, ...). |
| `rt_range_s` | array of 2 × `number` (double) or `null` |  | Retention-time range of the matching scans in seconds. |
| `scans` | array of [`ScanHeader`](#scanheader) | yes | The listed scans, in spectrum-index order. |

## Types

### ScanFilter

Which scans to list. Every condition that is set must hold.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ms_level` | `integer` (uint32) or `null` |  | Only this MS level (1 = full scans, 2 = MS/MS). |
| `polarity` | `string` or `null` |  | Only `positive` or `negative` scans. |
| `rt_min_s` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Retention time at least this many seconds. |
| `rt_max_s` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Retention time at most this many seconds. |
| `precursor_mz` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Precursor m/z near this value (within `precursor_tol_mz`, or `precursor_tol_ppm`). |
| `precursor_tol_mz` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Absolute precursor tolerance in m/z (default 0.01 when neither tolerance is given). |
| `precursor_tol_ppm` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Relative precursor tolerance in ppm. |
| `charge` | `integer` (int32) or `null` |  | Only precursors of this charge state. |
| `activation` | `string` or `null` |  | Only this activation (`HCD`, `CID`, ...; case-insensitive). |
| `filter_contains` | `string` or `null` |  | Only scans whose filter string contains this text (case-insensitive). |

### ScanHeader

Everything about one spectrum except its peaks.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `index` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Zero-based spectrum index within its run (`spectra --index`). |
| `scan_number` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Scan number as the instrument counts it (`spectra --scan`). |
| `native_id` | `string` or `null` |  | The spectrum's identifier in its file (mzML `id`), when it has one. |
| `ms_level` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | MS level: 1 for a full scan, 2 for a fragment (MS/MS) scan, and so on. |
| `rt_s` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Retention time in seconds; null when the file states none for this scan (such a scan never matches a retention-time filter). |
| `polarity` | `string` | yes | `positive`, `negative` or `unknown`. |
| `centroided` | `boolean` | yes | True when the stored peaks are centroids. |
| `precursor_mz` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | m/z of the isolated precursor ion (MS2 and above). |
| `precursor_charge` | `integer` (int32) or `null` |  | Charge state of the precursor, when the instrument determined it. |
| `precursor_intensity` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Intensity of the selected precursor ion, when recorded. |
| `isolation_window_mz` | array of 2 × `number` (double) or `null` |  | Precursor isolation window `[lower, upper]` in m/z. |
| `activation` | `string` or `null` |  | Dissociation method (`CID`, `HCD`, `ETD`, ...), upper case. |
| `collision_energy` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Collision energy as recorded. |
| `inverse_reduced_mobility` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Ion mobility 1/K0 in V·s/cm², when the scan or precursor has one. |
| `scan_filter` | `string` or `null` |  | Instrument scan filter or scan description (e.g. Thermo `FTMS + p ESI d Full ms2 …`). |
| `scan_window_mz` | array of 2 × `number` (double) or `null` |  | Scan (acquisition) window `[lower, upper]` in m/z. |
| `total_ion_current` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Total ion current as the file records it for the scan (an index or header value; not recomputed from the peaks). Absent when the file keeps none. |
| `base_peak_mz` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Base-peak m/z as the file records it for the scan. |
| `base_peak_intensity` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Base-peak intensity as the file records it for the scan. |
| `point_count` | `integer` (uint64) or `null` |  | Number of stored points (peaks or profile samples), when the header records it. |
| `extra` | object |  | Format-specific scan metadata in the reader's documented vocabulary. |
